verdict.rationale: Devin's own docs say you can run multiple Devins in parallel on independent tasks, and they list codebase-wide jobs like language migrations and framework upgrades. That approximates bulk work across many items, but each task must be carved out separately; there is no documented single bulk action applied to a selected set. Missing for 10: a native bulk/batch operation across many items (e.g. many tickets or repos in one command), documentation of batch semantics and limits, and independent hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can perform bulk operations across many items at once

citations.quote: Run multiple Devins in parallel: Carve out independent tasks and run them simultaneously.
